title: Swarm Configuration Builder
description: Build UI to define agent roles, capabilities, task routing rules, and model assignments for swarms. Save/load swarm configurations.
context: Users need an easy way to create swarm configurations without writing code. This tool lets them pick agents, assign roles, set routing rules, and save configs for reuse.
requirements: Create SwarmConfig page component in deepify-ai/src/pages/swarm-config.tsx
Agent selector: drag-and-drop or multi-select from employeeData.ts (all 28 agents)
Role assignment: designate which agent is orchestrator vs workers
Capability editor: define what each agent can do in this swarm
Task routing rules editor: create rules for which worker handles which task type
Model assignment UI: select Opus 4.6 or Sonnet 4.5 per agent (default: orchestrator=Opus, workers=Sonnet)
Load existing configurations from file or database
Configuration validation: ensure at least 1 orchestrator, at least 1 worker, no duplicate roles
Preview mode: show swarm structure before saving
acceptance_criteria: Can select agents from full employee list (28 agents)
Can assign orchestrator role to 1 agent
Can assign worker roles to multiple agents
Can define capabilities for each agent (text input or predefined list)
Can create task routing rules (if task type X, assign to agent Y)
Can override model assignment (Opus vs Sonnet) per agent
Save button creates valid JSON config file
Load button imports existing config and populates UI
Validation prevents invalid configs (errors shown clearly)
Follows Team in a Box design system

ui_components: SaveLoadButtons (save to file, load from file)

validation: Create a swarm config via UI, save it, reload page, load the config, verify all settings populate correctly. Then use that config to start a swarm.
